method: Manually traced landmarks in original left character image, pixel coordinates, approximate ±8 pixels. Single perspective concept; not an orthographic reconstruction or a score. Horns excluded from head envelope.
construction_response: Complete temple-to-nose components compressed to 86–90% transverse width, 96% length from fixed neck end, with up to 0.10 downward tip offset. Preserve narrow squint; brow root thickens and blends through shoulder gussets. Chin becomes split pointed ivory mandible. These are artistic interpretation, not direct conversion of perspective ratios into world units.
